# The oecd feed

OECD Data Explorer (SDMX).

The economy module's public-sector oecd pack (docs/guides/PUBLIC_SECTOR_GUIDE.md): The OECD members' business cycle, jobs, prices and growth from the OECD Data Explorer's SDMX API: the composite leading indicator, the harmonised unemployment rate, consumer price inflation and real GDP growth. A country's page shows the latest of each measure and the members on a map shaded by inflation; each series shows its monthly or quarterly history. Filled daily by the oecd feed into the worldlake lake.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | OECD (https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/) |
| Licence | [OECD terms and conditions (CC BY 4.0)](https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html): redistributable with attribution |
| Attribution | Source: OECD Data Explorer (CC BY 4.0). |
| Lake | `worldlake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 07:00 (local time) |
| Pull | `oecd.OecdFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/oecd.py); 4 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run oecd --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run oecd                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/oecd/<date>/, load into worldlake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status oecd             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [EXTERNAL_DATA.md](../../docs/guides/EXTERNAL_DATA.md).

## Data contract

### oecd-country

Pack `oecd`, kind `oecd-country` (OECD country), table `oecd-country`, key `COUNTRY_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/oecd/<date>/oecd-country.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COUNTRY_ID` | id | required | OECD- and the member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The member's name as the OECD writes it. |
| `ISO3` | text | required | The member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (the OECD's REF_AREA), the key the map shades by. |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional | The member's name as the OECD writes it. |
| `LEADING_INDICATOR` | amount | optional | The composite leading indicator, amplitude adjusted: above 100 and rising, growth above trend ahead. |
| `LEADING_INDICATOR_PERIOD` | text | optional | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | amount | optional | The harmonised unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted, ages 15 and over. |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT_PERIOD` | text | optional | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). |
| `INFLATION` | rate | optional | Consumer price inflation, all items, on the same month a year before. |
| `INFLATION_PERIOD` | text | optional | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). |
| `GDP_GROWTH` | rate | optional | Real GDP growth on the previous quarter, seasonally adjusted. |
| `GDP_GROWTH_PERIOD` | text | optional | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). |
| `MEASURES` | record list | required | Every measure the feed pulled for the member, one row each: MEASURE, TITLE, UNIT, LATEST, PERIOD, CHANGE and OECD_SERIES. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |
| `MEASURE_COUNT` | integer | required | How many measures have a value for the member. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"COUNTRY_ID": "OECD-AUS", "NAME": "Australia", "ISO3": "AUS", "COUNTRY_NAME": "Australia", "LEADING_INDICATOR": 99.9505, "LEADING_INDICATOR_PERIOD": "2026-09", "UNEMPLOYMENT": 4.718349, "UNEMPLOYMENT_PERIOD": "2026-09", "INFLATION": 4.34, "INFLATION_PERIOD": "2026-09", "GDP_GROWTH": 0.419502713, "GDP_GROWTH_PERIOD": "2026-Q2", "MEASURE_COUNT": 4}
```

The contract: `config/packs/oecd/contracts/oecd-country.contract.yaml` ([oecd](../../docs/contracts/packs/oecd.md)).

### oecd-series

Pack `oecd`, kind `oecd-series` (OECD series), table `oecd-series`, key `SERIES_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/oecd/<date>/oecd-series.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required | OECDS-, the member's ISO alpha-3 code and the measure's id. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The member and the measure, as one name. |
| `OECD_COUNTRY` | id | required | The member's oecd-country page (OECD-<ISO3>). |
| `ISO3` | text | required | The member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional | The member's name as the OECD writes it. |
| `MEASURE` | text | required | The measure's id in the feed's YAML. |
| `TITLE` | text | required | The measure's title in the feed's YAML. |
| `UNIT` | text | required | What the measure is in. |
| `DATAFLOW` | text | required | The OECD dataflow (agency, id, version) the series is read from. |
| `FREQUENCY` | text | optional | Monthly or quarterly, from the feed's YAML. |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | The latest value, in the unit shown. |
| `LATEST_PERIOD` | text | required | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). |
| `PREVIOUS` | amount | optional | The previous period's value. |
| `PREVIOUS_PERIOD` | text | optional | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | The latest value less the previous one. |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required | The value by period, oldest first, over the feed's history-periods (PERIOD, VALUE). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"SERIES_ID": "OECDS-USA-CLI", "NAME": "United States · Composite leading indicator", "OECD_COUNTRY": "OECD-USA", "ISO3": "USA", "COUNTRY_NAME": "United States", "MEASURE": "CLI", "TITLE": "Composite leading indicator", "UNIT": "index, long-term average = 100", "DATAFLOW": "OECD.SDD.STES,DSD_STES@DF_CLI,", "FREQUENCY": "monthly", "LATEST": 100.9993, "LATEST_PERIOD": "2026-09", "PREVIOUS": 100.9464, "PREVIOUS_PERIOD": "2026-08", "CHANGE": 0.0529}
```

The contract: `config/packs/oecd/contracts/oecd-series.contract.yaml` ([oecd](../../docs/contracts/packs/oecd.md)).
